title: Chiliz-maxxing
tagline: Tip. Earn. Own. A fan-owned streaming platform built on Chiliz
description: Chiliz maxxing is a decentralized livestreaming platform built on the Chiliz Spicy Testnet that transforms traditional audience engagement into true fan ownership.  As soon as a creator starts a livestream, the platform auto-deploys a unique creator token using Thirdweb + Chiliz. Viewers can earn or buy these tokens by watching, participating in chat, or tipping using CHZ. These tokens give fans a meaningful and on-chain stake in the creator’s journey.  We combine real-time streaming, tokenized membership, and on-chain tipping to reward genuine participation turning spectators into stakeholders.
how_its_made:
For the frontend, React and Vite power a fast, modular UI with an optimized developer experience, while Tailwind CSS enables a clean and responsive design system. Thirdweb SDK handles seamless wallet connectivity and on-chain interactions directly from the browser. For livestreaming, the platform integrates ZegoCloud, providing low-latency, high-quality real-time video and chat capabilities essential for creator–fan engagement.

On the blockchain side, all smart contracts are written in Solidity (v0.8.20) and developed using Hardhat for testing, deployments, and local simulation. OpenZeppelin libraries ensure secure, audited token standards and contract patterns. Ethers.js v5 is used for reliable interaction between the frontend and the Chiliz Spicy Testnet, powering features like token deployment, tipping, and event listening.
